preliminaryPositive.scope: Reloaded keyboard three-round split, request without fabricated observations, separate convergence observation, Space/Enter Reset, and twelve-round held split.
preliminaryPositive.note: Recorded before a behavior-preserving cohort-rule refactor and caption clarification; final positive checks were repeated on the final assets below.

excludedAttempt.failure: locator.click: Timeout 10000ms exceeded while the first enabled #request-convergence button awaited visible/enabled/stable actionability.
excludedAttempt.recovery: Serialized focus with sibling workers, opened a new owned forceNew page, reloaded and reran actual browser interactions. No force-click, mocked DOM, or successful negative-test claim was substituted for the timeout.

assertedActualDom: Both final blocks reloaded the actual local bundle, not generated markup or a mock DOM.
Form reset and submit methods were actual functions, not shadowed controls.
Control+A, typed 12, Tab, Tab, Enter held twelve rounds with a visible keyboard focus outline.
Further Tab/Enter actions requested 100% without changing prior observed 10/10 destinations, then separately observed all 20 fixture users on v2.
All twenty final positive rows showed schema 1, credits 987/987, tickets 13/13 and effects 1/1 after twelve held rounds and one convergence round.
Space on Reset restored defaults and focused hold-rounds; the old trace and observations were cleared without manufacturing success.
Unstable assignment failed round 2 even though round 3 passed; convergence was refused and user impact remained failed.
Ten incompatible v2 rows showed schema 2, credits 998/999, tickets 2/1 and effects 2/1. A later compatible sample did not repair the attempt.
Missing u20 observations had no invented destination, schema, credits or effect values.
A lagging convergence sample showed one v1 and nineteen v2 despite desired 100%; a later all-v2 sample retained the earlier failed user impact.
Missing convergence evidence stayed unknown with nineteen v2 and one unobserved user.
Invalid rounds preserved displayed destinations, phase, migration, impact, rows, history and action trace byte-for-byte.

A deliberately injected unrecognized option exercised actual hold and convergence input handlers; both rejected it without changing evidence. This was invalid-input DOM tampering, not mocked application behavior.
Invalid input after Reset left zero rounds, no observed destinations and unknown impact.
Final Reset and reload cleared only local in-memory evidence. All captured requests were local file assets; no HTTP requests, page errors or console/CSP errors occurred in the passing blocks.
limits: Finite invented observations are not Azure telemetry, traffic measurements or a reliability guarantee.
A passing guard check for a negative fixture does not mean affected users passed.
Only owned forceNew page IDs were used; no other worker's page was navigated or controlled.
The hidden-page timeout is retained as a failed infrastructure attempt and excluded from acceptance.
